rows.name: Caddy with built-in templates
rows.reason: Caddy templates can serve documents/fragments without another application server. HX-Request branching is inferred, untested. Use trusted templates; site roots are not symlink sandboxes. Alpine packaging unverified.

rows.name: Microsoft IIS for Windows Server
rows.reason: Its Windows Server platform conflicts with the mandatory Linux/Alpine production requirement, regardless of its web-serving capabilities.

rows.name: Caddy with its templates and file_server handlers
rows.reason: Single-process templates/header-dependent HTML; Linux/Windows documented, Alpine unverified. Security/minimalism unresolved: require trusted templates, dedicated public root, safe symlinks/privileges. API reference postdates question; unavoidable separate backend or unacceptable hardening rejects setup.

rows.name: Apache OpenOffice
rows.reason: Office-document suite, not the requested web server; decisive operating-role mismatch, distinct from Apache HTTP Server. Exclusion requires neither unsupported-feature inference nor a maintenance cutoff.

rows.name: Apache OpenOffice
rows.reason: An office productivity suite provides no relevant HTTP-serving or HTMX page-composition mechanism for this server-selection problem.

rows.name: Caddy
rows.reason: Static files/in-process templates/header access on Linux map interpreted HTMX without separate backend. Automatic HTTPS doesn't resolve security/minimalism or safe template/filesystem configuration. API reference postdates question; no decisive exclusion.

rows.name: Microsoft IIS for Windows Server
rows.reason: IIS requires Windows/Windows Server, conflicting with Linux production. Docker permission covers Windows development only; it does not authorize Windows Server production. Price/security/extensibility cannot offset this platform mismatch.

rows.name: nginx with ngx_http_ssi_module
rows.reason: Nginx SSI can compose files/HTMX responses without another application server. Enable/configure SSI; nesting is limited. Security/minimalism, Alpine packaging and Windows parity remain unverified; demonstrate safe full-page/fragment behavior.

rows.name: Static Web Server v2 with htmx hx-select
rows.reason: Static Web Server v2/htmx selects fragments from complete preassembled pages. No runtime templates or server fragment-only responses; build-time assembly required. Release security defaults and extensions unaudited.

rows.name: nginx Server Side Includes
rows.reason: SSI includes/conditionals and header variables suggest HTMX handling, untested. Disabled by default; conditional nesting limited. Windows/Alpine packaging and full secure configuration unverified.

rows.name: lighttpd with mod_ssi — unverified lead
rows.reason: Lighttpd mod_ssi is an unverified inclusion lead: official docs blocked. Verify Linux HX-Request conditional composition without separate backend; inaccessible evidence does not establish incompatibility.

rows.name: Caddy
rows.reason: Built-in templates expose request headers and file inclusion, supporting static pages and HTMX fragments within one server; trusted templates and filesystem precautions remain necessary.
